newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Bunds look to 102.05 resistance next.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Bunds look to 102.05 resistance next.

text.p: June Bund futures on LIFFE popped above last week's resistance zone in early trade on Tuesday and will target higher levels around 102.05, analysts said.
"We opened above the 101.80 level and that's bullish," Geert-Jan Nikken, techncial analyst at ABN-AMRO Hoare Govett in Amsterdam, said. "All in all we focus on higher levels."
June Bunds were quoted at 101.86 at 0652 GMT, up 31 basis points from Friday. LIFFE was closed on Monday for a holiday.
"The level we have in mind is the 102.05 area," Nikken said. "This is a level back on the reverse head and shoulders area and coincides with the level we have seen in early March."
The contract hit a high of 102.02 on March 2 and a 102.18 high on March 11, but was unable to hold these levels.
Nikken said the 101.80 area would provide initial support, with the high on Friday coming in at 101.82 and Thursday's high at 101.80.
"If we take out the 101.80 to the downside, support comes in nearby," he said, citing previous resistance on hourly charts at 101.69, then previous support at 101.46.
Gerry Celaya, senior technical analyst at American Express Bank in London, said last Thursday's and Friday's lows at 101.45 and 101.32 should provide solid support for the contract.
He too was bullish on the contract.
"Over the last month or so it's been forming a decent basing pattern," he said. He said the contract would first target 102.18 then could aim for the old highs around 103.20 set in February.
June Euromarks were quoted at 96.79 at 0714 GMT, up one basis point from Friday.
